summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, announcing a non-binding MOU between Sony Semiconductor Solutions (its wholly-owned subsidiary) and TSMC to form a strategic joint venture for next-gen image sensors. Sony would be majority and controlling shareholder; no specific price, premium, or timeline given. Deal depends on definitive agreements, government support, and customary closing. The JV targets development/production in Kumamoto, Japan. Not a direct corporate restructuring or acquisition of a public target; rather a partnership/JV formation. Filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a preliminary agreement, not a special situation warranting the listed categories.
